extraction.Name: Frank Shadlow
extraction.Refused/Protested: with protest; allottee says that he did not want the Government to issue him a patent on his land, that the same was against his wishes
extraction.Recorded patent: yes, filed for record in Noble County
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Sold S/2 for $4500 and paid a mortgage on land for $550.00
extraction.Buyer: $4500.00 to Byron Phipps, no old debts to settle
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: no land sold for debt or taxes; Mortgage released
extraction.Occupation/Income: No income of any kind nor contribution of any sort
extraction.NOTES: Good health; no property or funds accumulated; none dependent upon the Indian for support; no evidence of fraud in this case; patent receipted for by Supt. Hoyo; document notarized November 22, 1928 in Kay County, Oklahoma; notary commission expires Aug. 3rd, 1931; oua. 61391
